newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli provident funds like Koor, IDB Development.
newsitem.headline: Israeli provident funds like Koor, IDB Development.

text.p: Koor Industries Ltd and I.D.B. Development Corp are the most popular stocks with Israel's provident funds, a report by Meitav Investments and Securities said on Tuesday.
It said in December 1996 the five biggest provident fund managers held a total of 399 million shekels in Koor and the same amount in I.D.B Development.
After those stocks the most popular shares were Israel Chemicals, Bank Leumi and Discount Investment Corp Ltd.
In December 1995, the most popular stocks, in order, were Koor, Discount Investment, I.D.B. Development, I.D.B. Holdings and Bank Leumi, Meitav said.

The five biggest provident fund managers, which are the five biggest commercial banks in Israel, at year end 1996 held assets totalling 71.3 billion shekels. These banks manage 64 percent of the total assets of Israeli provident funds.
